id: title:jose-sequeira:disable vacuum truncation on the publish outbox

review.posthog_relevance: Database maintenance and identity publishing performance
review.reason: Adds a PostgreSQL migration to disable vacuum_truncate on person_publish_outbox and person_publish_outbox_tmp tables. This could prevent PostgreSQL autovacuum from repeatedly polling for an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock on these tables, potentially reducing database contention and CPU usage during identity publishing, assuming the migration is successfully applied.
review.uncertainty: This chunk lacks the Rust implementation, configuration, or tests demonstrating how PostHog actually uses this migration, the database schema, or the migration execution. It is impossible to distinguish whether this migration is applied, tested, or its actual impact on PostHog's identity publishing workflow. The benefit is conjectural and not demonstrated by the provided code.
